title: Zweite Verordnung zur Änderung der Soldatenarbeitszeitverordnung vom 23. September 2022 (BGBl. 2022 I Nr. 34, S. 1533 bis 1538), full gazette text, layout order (the annex table keeps its rows with their states; two-column running text is interleaved)
verified_how: curl was answered with an HTML shell that needs JavaScript (no PDF).
